title: ResourceEndpoint Definition v1

TechnologyKind.description: TechnologyKind that owns protocol/build semantics for this endpoint.

ResourceKind.description: Resource kind addressed by this endpoint.

Visibility.description: Public/private resource namespace of the endpoint.

Id.description: Stable resource endpoint identifier used by resource-resolution selection.

Url.description: Provider endpoint URL. It may be omitted by an inherited amendment but must exist on the effective endpoint.

CredentialProfile.description: Optional credential-profile identifier; secret values are never stored here.

Enabled.description: Optional participation flag. It inherits when omitted and defaults to true after inheritance.

Stability.description: Release/snapshot stability where required by the ResourceKind.

description: Defines one ResourceEndpoint declaration before inheritance/default resolution. The generated data object preserves nullable amendment fields; the effective Builder model applies defaults and semantic rules separately.
